summary: Reorders channels by numeric pattern, name pattern, sort method, random order, grouping, or a second reference CHOP without changing channel values.

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Numeric pattern, character pattern, base-name sort, numeric-suffix sort, value sort, reverse, random, group, or split mode

key_params.name: orderref
key_params.note: Interpret optional second input as channel names or sample indices

key_params.name: rempos
key_params.note: Place unmatched channels at beginning or end

key_params.name: remorder
key_params.note: Keep unmatched channels in input order or alphanumeric order

key_concepts: Reorder CHOP changes the order of channels without changing any channel values.
Channels can be reordered by numeric pattern, character pattern, base-name sort, numeric-suffix sort, value sort, reverse, random, group, or split modes.
When an Order Reference input is connected, Numeric Pattern and Character Pattern are ignored.
Order Reference can use channel names or a single channel of sample indices to define the output order.
Use Sort CHOP for sample ordering inside channels; Reorder CHOP is for channel order relative to other channels.
common_gotchas: Channel values are never affected; only channel order changes.
When a second Order Reference input is present, numeric and character patterns are ignored.
By-name reference uses channel names; by-index reference expects a single channel whose sample values specify the order.
Use Sort CHOP to reorder samples inside channels; use Reorder CHOP to reorder channels relative to each other.
Random reorders need an explicit seed for reproducible generated networks.
